item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.curse: Curse I: Edict of the Twin Gods
-> Every %1$s minutes, gain 1 random negative effect for %2$s seconds at levels %3$s to %4$s.
Curse II: Regent's Crown
-> Every 5 minutes worn removes 2 Luck and may periodically summon hostile creatures.
Curse III: Tax of the Royal Name
-> Experience from any kill becomes %1$s, enchanting cost becomes %2$s times, and anvil cost becomes %3$s times.
Curse IV: Contract of the Two Lands
-> Villager and wandering trader prices increase by %s.
Curse V: Scale of the Innocent

-> Each innocent kill adds 1 King's Guilt. At %1$s, inventory is sealed for %2$s minutes and %3$s lightning strikes descend. After inversion, hostile kills build Mercy until the configured threshold stores one death reversal.
Curse VI: Treaty Shackles
-> After %1$s minutes, the main hand is sealed for %2$s minutes. After that, 1 random item is locked every %3$s minutes for %4$s minutes.
Curse VII: Judgment of the End
-> Entering the End leaves a mark; the no-loot chance is configurable.
Curse VIII: Nether Brand
-> After the first Nether entry, attacks on monsters have a %1$s chance to rebound, dealing %2$s extra damage to you.
Curse IX: Hunger King's Relic
-> Each death removes 2 hunger points and automatically grants 1 Satiety Crystal. Solve three inscriptions inside it to restore Hunger Debt and attributes.
item.ramesses_curse.seal_of_kadesh.story: The Seal of Kadesh does not preserve a victory. It seals the price a dynasty refused to confess between gold and stone.
It is like a regent's crown that never leaves the brow, writing commands for its bearer without ever giving a reason.
Every summoned hostility and every carved scar is its way of singing an old royal name again.
When you believe you merely borrowed an ornament, the seal has already entered your name into its years.
So what it truly binds is not the wrist, but a life standing before the dying embers of power.
